rationale.faithful: A well-composed site that earns its 86/100; respect the breathing space and the grotesk clarity patients expect.

rationale.reimagined: Dark ground signals expertise and competence; a confident clinic unafraid of modern, bold presence.

rationale.faithful: La marca azul ya comunica el viaje submarino; refuerza su escala de tipografía y densidad respirada.

rationale.reimagined: Un buceo nocturno bajo el océano: inversión de luz a tinta, energía audaz para familias que buscan lo extraordinario.

rationale.faithful: Law requires absolute clarity; their flat heading ramp suggests they prioritize consistency over hierarchy.
